# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities through this repository's **Security → Report a
vulnerability** page. If private vulnerability reporting is not enabled, ask the
maintainer to enable it without publishing exploit details or credentials.

Only the current default-branch template is maintained; generated repositories
must manage their own updates and disclosure policy.

Never attach tokens, private keys, or production data to issues or CI logs.
Dependency and scanner gates reduce risk but do not establish that an application
is secure. Verify repository protection settings before publishing or deploying.
